view: PA (frontal; recorded PA, L marker at image upper-right confirms conventional orientation)
technical_quality: Adequate: good inspiration (approx. 9 posterior ribs), adequate penetration, no significant rotation; scapulae partly project over the lateral upper lung fields; costophrenic angles included.

devices.type: Round snap-type radiopaque artifact (garment/gown snap or ECG electrode stud), external
devices.location: Projected over the mid-thoracic spine / mediastinum at approximately the hilar level (about T6-T7), midline

devices.type: Round snap-type radiopaque artifact (garment/gown snap or ECG electrode stud), external
devices.location: Projected over the lower thoracic spine / upper abdomen just right of midline (about T11-T12)

abnormalities.finding: Large, well-circumscribed, homogeneous rounded mass with a smooth convex inferior margin, occupying most of the right upper lobe, extending inferiorly to about the level of the right hilum; separated from the mediastinum by a thin strip of aerated lung. Approx. 7 x 12 cm (about 9 cm). No cavitation or calcification seen within it.
abnormalities.zone: upper (extends into the middle zone at hilar level)

abnormalities.finding: Two small dense nodules (probable calcified granulomas or calcified hilar lymph nodes) in the right hilar region, adjacent to the inferior margin of the mass
Mild elevation of the right hemidiaphragm relative to the left (about 2.5 cm); may be a normal variant or reflect right lung volume loss / phrenic involvement - uncertain
Prominent, unfolded / tortuous aortic knob, likely age-related atherosclerotic ectasia; heart size within normal limits

description_zh: 胸部正面（PA）X光：右上肺野可見一大型、邊緣清楚、密度均勻的圓形腫塊，下緣呈平滑凸面，佔據右上葉大部分並向下延伸至右肺門高度，與縱膈之間仍有薄層含氣肺組織相隔，估計約 7 x 12 公分（約 9 公分），內部未見明顯空洞或鈣化；右肺門處另見兩枚小而緻密的結節，可能為鈣化肉芽腫或鈣化淋巴結。右側橫膈較左側輕度抬高（約 2.5 公分），主動脈弓突出迂曲，心臟大小正常，左肺野清晰，兩側肋膈角銳利，未見肋膜積液或氣胸。另於中胸椎及下胸椎/上腹部中線附近見兩枚圓形環狀外物投影（衣物暗扣或心電圖電極扣），無胸管、引流管或其他治療痕跡。
